# P0 五家一对一触达包（R10 · 2026-10-18）

> **红线总控（U28/U29/U31）**：不提 Made in China/产地、不提研究过对方官网、一次一问、不夹带价格
>（回问后走"核价三档"）、称呼拼写核对、不虚报认证（CE/FCC 触达欧美前核实）。
> 跟进节奏：D0 首封 → D+3 未回短跟进（换角度一问）→ D+7 二次价值（案例/规格一图）→ D+14 收尾（问"找供应商还是找项目？"）。
> 报价单：RMB 未税 EXW 三档=SmartByte 成本×1.20/1.25/1.30；USD 按当日汇率（内部参考 7.2）；先核价。

## P0-1 FONPERU SAC（秘鲁电信系统集成商）
**切入点**：电信接入集成 + 实验室自研测试（爱立信/诺基亚生态）；秘鲁无硬认证强制（API/未强制）。
**建议报价单品目**：STC-3408GTM-P（8GE PoE+/4SFP）；工业旁路备选（按需）。
**首封（ES，一次一问）**：
> Asunto: Consulta rápida sobre su proyecto de acceso
>
> Hola, mi nombre es Kevin, de Saga Telecom. Estamos conversando con integradores de telecomunicaciones en Perú sobre equipos de capa de acceso — incluyendo switches de acceso PoE y bypass óptico para monitoreo en línea — con soporte de laboratorio propio para pruebas de interoperabilidad. **¿Su equipo actualmente evalúa nuevos proveedores de equipamiento de acceso, o la prioridad es desarrollar proyectos de integración con clientes finales?**
> Quedo atento. Saludos, Kevin — Saga Telecom
**跟进**：D+3 若提"evaluamos"→反问三件套（QTY/时间表/现供）后报三档。

## P0-2 Starview Technology（新加坡/马来，Alcatel-Lucent 代销+MikroTik 总代）
**切入点**：Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise 代销与服务经验=品牌生态兼容；MikroTik 总代=对其价格/货期痛点知根知底。
**建议报价单品目**：STC-424DGGM（对比 MikroTik CRS326 锚 $209 的价差/交期）；STI-402G（工业）。
**首封（EN）**：
> Subject: Quick question about your Alcatel-Lucent & MikroTik lines
>
> Hi, my name is Kevin, from Saga Telecom. We supply access-layer switching — L2+/L3 managed and industrial — that is compatible with mainstream ecosystems and typically ships within 5–7 days, with OEM/ODM customization available. Many partners who carry Alcatel-Lucent and MikroTik use us to cover price-competitive access projects without changing their existing portfolio. **Are you currently taking on new access-layer suppliers for price-competitive tenders?**
> Best regards, Kevin — Saga Telecom
**跟进**：D+3 提"catalog/price list"→回问目标场景后发三档。

## P0-3 PalC Networks Pvt. Ltd.（**印度**，SONiC 生态+系统集成）【R11 勘误：原误标巴西】
**切入点**：SONiC 生态成员（2024 新晋）+ 开放网络平台集成；**不适用 ANATEL**（巴西线专属首问）。
**建议报价单品目**：STC-424DGGM / STC-424XGGM（场景定）；开放网络配套。
**首封（EN，一次一问）**：
> Subject: Quick question about your open networking projects
>
> Hi, my name is Kevin, from Saga Telecom. We supply access-layer switching (L2+/L3 managed, PoE+, 10G uplinks) as white-label hardware for SONiC-based and open networking deployments, with OEM/ODM flexibility and short lead times. **For your open networking projects, is the access-layer hardware currently covered in-house, or are you qualifying additional hardware partners?**
> Best regards, Kevin — Saga Telecom
**跟进**：答复→产品对位→三档（USD 按当日汇率）。

## P0-4 MBUZZ（沙特/阿联酋，AI+DC 集成，Magna AI MoU）
**切入点**：2026-09 Magna AI(NVIDIA) MoU + Submer×Edgecore META MoU（2026-09-14 迪拜）——AI DC 主干潮的园区接入配套。
**建议报价单品目**：STC-6448DGTM（25G/园区汇聚）；旁路系（DC 出口监控场景）。
**首封（EN）**：
> Subject: One question after the Magna AI announcement
>
> Hi, my name is Kevin, from Saga Telecom. Congratulations on the Magna AI (NVIDIA) partnership — with the Submer × Edgecore META MoU as well, AI datacenter projects across the Kingdom and UAE are clearly accelerating. For the campus and access layer around those datacenter deployments, we supply access and aggregation switching (25G uplinks, PoE++, ERPS) with fast lead times and OEM/ODM flexibility — complements the datacenter backbone rather than competing with it. **For the access layer around your AI projects, is that covered in-house today or are you still looking at suppliers?**
> Best regards, Kevin — Saga Telecom
**跟进**：D+3 若"looking"→问接口场景/规模→三档+交期承诺。
